name: Losar de la Vera (Spain)
description: White field with a green hoist stripe of one fifth of the length, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Losar de la Vera (a bridge above waves on green with roundels).
history: The arms and the flag of Losar de la Vera were approved by the Order of 7 April 2003 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 22 April 2003, after the municipal council's approval on 1 April 2003; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, with a fifth at the hoist and the municipal arms at the centre at 3/5 of the width.

features.role: Losar de la Vera arms — bridge above waves with roundels
